# laravelforge_server (Resource)

Manages a Laravel Forge server within an organization. Provider-specific provisioning blocks (hetzner, aws, …) and tags are not modelled in this pass.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Underlying server provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL). Create-only.
- `name` (String) Server name (max 30 characters). Updatable.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `type` (String) Server type (e.g. `app`, `web`, `database`). Create-only.

### Optional

- `credential_id` (Number) ID of the provider credential to provision with. Create-only.
- `database_type` (String) Database engine key (e.g. `postgres15`). Create-only.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address. Updatable.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version key (e.g. `php82`). Create-only.
- `private_ip_address` (String) Private IP address. Updatable.
- `timezone` (String) Server timezone. Updatable.
- `ubuntu_version` (String) Ubuntu version (e.g. `22.04`, `24.04`). Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server.
- `is_ready` (Boolean) Whether the server has finished provisioning.
- `region` (String) Region the server runs in.
- `size` (String) Server size / plan.
- `slug` (String) Server slug.
